title: Internal MVP launcher contract tests v0
problem: Ticket-411 proves the Windows launcher manually, but its mock-only environment, GO gate, scratch paths, and localhost port boundary are not protected by an automated regression test.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic unit test verifies the launcher sets RGE_LLM_MODE=mock and RGE_ALLOW_LIVE_LLM=0 before invoking product proof.
The test verifies scratch work/artifact paths and an explicit product_verdict GO gate before npm starts.
The test verifies Next.js binds to 127.0.0.1:3000 and no command starts port 8000.
Tests inspect the script without starting product proof, Node, live network, or live LLM services.
non_goals: Changing launcher behavior beyond fixes required by the contract test.
Pester adoption or broad PowerShell test infrastructure.
Live OpenAI, OpenAlex, Ollama, or port 8000 FastAPI.
rollback_plan: Delete the launcher contract test and revert only any ticket-scoped launcher correction.
